tasks.title: Email about museum late-opening trial
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Museum late-opening trial
paragraphs: As you know, our town museum is planning a late-opening trial on Friday evenings. The museum wants to attract more young people. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should the museum offer free entry on those evenings or keep the normal ticket price? Which do you think is better for attracting visitors?
Also, we need to choose one extra activity for the late openings. Would you prefer a guided tour or a hands-on workshop?
Finally, can you suggest one way to let local teenagers know about the trial?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which ticket option you prefer and explain why.
Choose an activity (guided tour or workshop) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to inform teenagers about the trial.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the start time of the late opening.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about museum late-opening trial
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: You see this notice on a specialist magazine website for museum organisers.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town museum is trying late openings on Friday evenings.
Do you think this will help more young people visit the museum?
What is the most important thing the museum should do to make the trial a success?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about museum late-opening trial
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:

promptBlocks.label: Opening sentence
promptBlocks.text: When the programme coordinator turned off the main lights, the museum suddenly felt like a different world.
